Check the voltage of each PV string with a multimeter.
If the voltage of the PV string is lower than 550V, contact Growatt.
records.safety_warning: The manual states that the inverter contains energized components and only qualified and trained technicians can open it; high voltage can cause serious injury or death. Do not work on the product during operation. For Error 200, the manual warns of danger of fire from electric arc and states the AFCI trips as a safety measure.
records.verification_notes: Record extracted directly from the supplied official Growatt MIC TL-X2 manual. No unsupported causes or classifications were inferred.

Check the AC wiring, paying extra attention to the neutral and ground wires.
Check if the grid frequency complies with local grid standards. Restart the inverter, if the problem persists, contact Growatt.
records.safety_warning: The manual states that the inverter contains energized components and only qualified and trained technicians can open it; high voltage can cause serious injury or death. Do not work on the product during operation. For Error 200, the manual warns of danger of fire from electric arc and states the AFCI trips as a safety measure.
records.verification_notes: Record extracted directly from the supplied official Growatt MIC TL-X2 manual. No unsupported causes or classifications were inferred.

records.safety_warning: Manual is for qualified personnel. Electrical installation, repairs and conversions must be carried out by electrically qualified persons. records.meaning: The battery is bad or weak
troubleshooting_steps: Contact technical support.
records.safety_warning: Qualified maintenance personnel only for repairs. Hazardous voltages remain inside after mains disconnection because the UPS remains connected to batteries; before service, disconnect batteries and verify no current/hazardous voltage. Batteries can cause electric shock and high short-circuit current; remove metal jewelry and use insulated tools. Do not dismantle the UPS. Do not install near water/moist environments, direct sunlight/heaters, or block ventilation. Do not overload UPS outputs.
records.verification_notes: Added for the initial UPS test dataset from the cited Vertiv manufacturer manual. No unsupported cause or action was inferred.

records.error_code_or_warning: UPS will not turn on or there is no output
records.meaning: The UPS is not turned on, not connected to utility power, has a tripped input circuit breaker, has very low or no input utility voltage, has an unsecured battery connector, or has detected an internal fault.
records.possible_causes: Unit not turned on; UPS not connected to utility power; input circuit breaker tripped; very low or no input utility voltage; battery connector not securely connected; internal fault.
troubleshooting_steps: Press the ON key once to turn on the UPS.
Be sure the power cable is securely connected to the unit and utility power supply.
Reduce the load, disconnect nonessential equipment, and reset the circuit breaker.
Check utility power with a table lamp.
Be sure battery connections are secure.
If an internal fault is detected, do not attempt to use the UPS; unplug it and have it serviced immediately.

growatt: The manual is for qualified personnel.
Electrical installation, repairs and conversions may only be carried out by electrically qualified persons.
There is residual voltage in the inverter; the manual states the inverter takes 20 minutes to discharge.
AC and DC voltage sources are terminated inside the PV inverter; disconnect these circuits before servicing.
High voltage may remain after disconnection; follow the manual's safety instructions before servicing.
The manual warns not to ground the DC circuits of PV modules connected to the MIN TL-X.

Non-professionals are not allowed to operate the equipment or repair, modify or disassemble the inverter; only qualified technicians with professional training are permitted to install and operate it.
Do not work with power on and do not connect or disconnect power cables while the system is operating.
Before routine maintenance, power off the system and wait 5 minutes for the capacitor to discharge to a safe level.
Do not wear conductive objects such as watches, bracelets, bangles or rings during operation.
Wear helmets, goggles, insulated gloves, reflective clothes and safety shoes during operation; use insulated tools.
The inverter must be properly grounded and the air inlet/outlet must not be obstructed.
PV modules generate high DC voltage when exposed to light; the inverter DC switch must be OFF before connecting cables.
Unqualified persons must not perform electrical connections.
The manual recommends firefighting equipment such as fire sand and fire extinguishers on site.
For battery systems, high voltage remains after the battery is powered off; the manual states it takes 5 minutes to discharge to safe voltage.
The manual labels risks of high voltage/electric shock, fire and burns from hot surfaces.
MIN TL-X2 manual: qualified personnel are required for transport, installation, start-up and maintenance.
Disconnect the inverter on both AC and DC sides before work; high voltages can be present in conductive parts.
PV arrays supply DC voltage when exposed to light; never connect or disconnect DC connectors under load.
Do not ground the DC positive or DC negative PV array poles because of the transformerless design.
The manual states residual voltage remains and the inverter takes 20 minutes to discharge.
Do not open the inverter except the wire box by qualified persons; damaged inverters must not be touched.
Do not install the inverter on easily flammable/thermolabile materials or where flammable materials are stored.
Do not stay closer than 20 cm to the inverter for any length of time.
Use appropriate ESD precautions when replacing/installing the inverter.
A Type A RCD with residual current rating not less than 300mA is specified if an external RCD is mandatory in the installation country.
The inverter must be properly grounded to the AC grounding conductor; PV positive and negative poles are not permitted to be grounded.
For AFCI Error 200, the manual identifies electric-arc danger and requires the specified shutdown/check/restart procedure.
eaton: Battery servicing should be performed by qualified service personnel knowledgeable of batteries and required precautions.
Batteries can present a risk of electrical shock or burn from high short-circuit current.
Do not open or mutilate batteries; released electrolyte is harmful and may be toxic.
Do not disconnect batteries while the UPS is in Battery mode.
Power outlets may remain energized while the UPS is disconnected from AC power.
global_safety.vertiv_ups: Qualified maintenance personnel only for repairs. Hazardous voltages remain inside after mains disconnection because the UPS remains connected to batteries; before service, disconnect batteries and verify no current/hazardous voltage. Batteries can cause electric shock and high short-circuit current; remove metal jewelry and use insulated tools. Do not dismantle the UPS. Do not install near water/moist environments, direct sunlight/heaters, or block ventilation. Do not overload UPS outputs.

coverage_summary.family_expansion_policy: Family-level evidence was duplicated only for exact catalog models explicitly listed in applicable_models; source content and citations were unchanged.
coverage_summary.dataset_note: Single combined solar-inverter + UPS knowledge base. Growatt family records are expanded to exact catalog models for deterministic backend retrieval. Vertiv UPS entries remain limited to the cited official manuals and their extracted troubleshooting tables; no unsupported UPS faults were invented.

important_design_note: MIN 7000-10000 TL-X2 is now covered by the uploaded official GR-UM-292-A-00 manual. X2 troubleshooting records are model-family records with exact four-model applicability. Numeric codes are not assumed to have one meaning across issue types; type/title context is preserved. MOD 10-15KTL3-X models were added from supplied official datasheet content. Only unambiguously model-mapped values were structured; ambiguous pasted-table rows were preserved as extraction notes and not inferred. No fault records were invented. Official manufacturer additions were merged only when each record had an official source URL and exact printed page; documented coverage shortfalls were not padded. Exact duplicate evidence rows were deduplicated by model, code/condition, issue, meaning, and source citation; distinct issues sharing a code were retained. Family-level additions were expanded only across explicit applicable_models so the existing backend catalog and exact retrieval can expose every verified catalog model.

sections.intended_use: Single-phase grid-tied PV inverter; permanent connection to public power grid; not intended for mobile use.
sections.pv_capacitive_discharge: PV modules with large capacitance to earth may only be used if coupling capacity does not exceed 1uF; normal leakage current may not exceed 50mA.

installation.orientation: Vertical; connections downward; never horizontal; avoid forward/sideways tilt
installation.direct_sunlight: Do not expose directly to sunlight
installation.clearances: Minimum clearances are shown in manual figures; 30cm and 50cm clearances are explicitly shown in the installation figures.
installation.flammable_materials: Do not install on inflammable or thermolabile materials or where flammable materials are stored

electrical_connection.external_rCD_if_mandatory: Type A RCD with residual current rating not less than 300mA
electrical_connection.voc_rule: Maximum open-circuit voltage of each PV string must be less than the inverter maximum input voltage.
electrical_connection.pv_grounding: PV positive and negative poles are not permitted to be grounded; inverter must connect to AC grounding conductor via PE.
electrical_connection.second_protective_conductor: Where required by installation country/IEC 62109, at least 10mm² Cu on AC terminal or same cross-section as original protective conductor on earth terminal.

drms.DRM6: Do not generate at more than 50% of rated power
drms.DRM7: Do not generate at more than 75% of rated power AND sink reactive power if capable
drms.DRM8: Increase power generation (subject to constraints from other active DRMs)
drms.external_voltage_limit: DRMs PORT external voltage must not exceed +5V

afci.error_200: If Error 200 is displayed, the buzzer alarms, an electric arc occurred in the PV system; AFCI has tripped and inverter is in permanent shutdown.
afci.reset: A tripped AFCI can only be reset manually.
procedure: Turn the DC & AC Disconnect to OFF.
Wait for the display to go out.
Check all PV strings for the correct open-circuit voltage.
After the fault is rectified, turn the DC & AC Disconnect to ON.

sections.earth_fault_alarm: Complies with IEC62109-2; when earth fault occurs the Red LED lights and buzzer keeps ringing until fault condition is cleared; function only available for Australia and New Zealand.

startup: Turn on DC switch; inverter starts automatically when input voltage is higher than 60V.
commissioning.country_default: If no country is selected, Australia & Region A defaults to AS/NZS4777.2, otherwise VDE0126-1-1 after 30s.

touch_control.hold_5s: Confirm country setting or recover number default value

settings.reset_factory_warning: All configured parameters except current date, time, and model parameters will be restored to factory defaults.

communications.rs485_ports: Two RS485 ports: one for inverter communication and one for smart meter/export limitation.
communications.usb_a: Used for optional monitor connection and firmware update.

maintenance.heat_dissipation: If output is regularly reduced due to high temperature, improve heat dissipation; heat sink may need cleaning.
maintenance.cleaning: Turn off AC breaker and DC switch; wait for shutdown; clean enclosure lid/display/LEDs with wet cloth only; do not use solvents or abrasives.
maintenance.dc_isolator: Inspect regularly for visible damage/discoloration; contact installer if damaged; once a year turn rotary switch ON to OFF 5 times in succession.

dismantling: Lift inverter off bracket and unscrew bracket screws.
decommissioning.cooling_wait: Wait 20 minutes before disassembling until housing has cooled.
decommissioning.disposal: Do not dispose of faulty inverter/accessories with household waste; follow electronic-waste disposal regulations.
